business: Global pharmaceutical company serving 100+ countries. Develops, manufactures and distributes innovative medicines, branded generics, generics, APIs and consumer healthcare products. Largest pharma in India; 13th largest US generics company.

segments.name: Innovative Medicines
segments.comment: Specialty focus: dermatology, ophthalmology, onco-dermatology. Strategic priority

segments.name: US Business
segments.comment: Growing Innovative Medicines now exceed generics share of US revenue

segments.name: India
segments.comment: Market leader with 8.4% share. Volume-led growth driver

segments.name: Emerging Markets
segments.comment: 80+ countries. Diversification and long-term growth opportunities

revenue_mix: 67% international from established operations. Innovative Medicines 22% of total. Volume-led India growth. Specialty medicines increasingly valuable globally.
strategy: Advance Innovative Medicines in dermatology, ophthalmology, onco-dermatology via R&D and acquisitions
Expand global reach via Organon acquisition adding Women's Health therapeutic pillar
Maintain cost leadership while investing 6.1% of sales in R&D for innovation
Build manufacturing resilience across 40 facilities with quality focus
Balance long-term innovation with near-term profitability across geographies
outlook: Global pharma market reaching US$2.4T by 2029 (CAGR 5-8%). India market growth 6.5-9.5% CAGR. Organon acquisition enhancing global scale and Women's Health portfolio. Specialty medicines driving value. Focus on clinical differentiation addressing unmet needs.
capex_plans: Ongoing investment in 40 global manufacturing facilities, 6 R&D centers and digital capabilities. Organon acquisition expanding manufacturing footprint and regional presence.
risks: MFN pricing from 2026 creating downward price pressure and near-term market uncertainty
Loss of Exclusivity intensifying: US$179B projected erosion over 5 years vs US$49B prior
Section 232 tariff investigations on pharma products, APIs, critical inputs pending outcomes
Regulatory complexity, geopolitical uncertainty and supply chain unpredictability
flags: Leadership transition: Kirti Ganorkar appointed Managing Director; Dilip Shanghvi continues as Executive Chairman. Organon acquisition announced post-FY26, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.
